summary: NICE Ltd. furnished a routine Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US analogue of an 8-K) containing two press releases announcing industry analyst recognition: an IDC MarketScape Leaders placement for Worldwide Agentic Contact Center-as-a-Service Platforms (doc #US54117326, dated 1 October 2026) and a 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leaders position for Contact Center as a Service (dated 21 October 2026). No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. The excerpt references, without terms, the company's 2025 acquisition of NiCE Cognigy. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
